summary: Leader and rapper of BTS. Known for his songwriting, producing, and fluent English, RM has been a key voice for the group at global stages including the United Nations.
Vocalist and eldest member of BTS. Known for his vocal range and humor, Jin released the solo single 'The Astronaut' in collaboration with Coldplay.
Rapper, songwriter, and producer of BTS. Also active as solo artist Agust D, known for introspective lyrics addressing mental health and social issues.
Rapper, dancer, and performer of BTS. Recognized as a main dancer, J-Hope headlined Lollapalooza 2022, becoming the first South Korean artist to headline a major U.S. music festival.
Vocalist and dancer of BTS. Known for his contemporary dance background and expressive performances, Jimin's solo debut 'FACE' debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200.
Vocalist of BTS. Known for his deep baritone voice and artistic sensibility, V has also pursued acting and released solo work exploring jazz and R&B influences.
Main vocalist of BTS. Known as the 'Golden Maknae' for his versatile talents, Jungkook performed at the 2022 FIFA World Cup opening ceremony and achieved multiple solo Billboard Hot 100 entries.
Vocalist and visual of BLACKPINK. Also active as an actress, starring in the K-drama 'Snowdrop' (2021). Her solo debut 'ME' topped charts across Asia.
Rapper and vocalist of BLACKPINK. First member to launch a solo career with 'Solo' (2018), she is also known as a fashion icon and Chanel ambassador.

Main vocalist of BLACKPINK. Born in New Zealand and raised in Australia, Rosé's solo debut 'On The Ground' set multiple records as the highest-charting song by a Korean female soloist on the Billboard Hot 100.
Main dancer, rapper, and sub vocalist of BLACKPINK. Born in Thailand, Lisa is one of the most-followed K-pop idols on social media and her solo debut 'Lalisa' broke multiple YouTube records.
Leader of NewJeans. Known for her charismatic stage presence and all-rounder capabilities, Minji has been a Chanel ambassador since the group's debut.
Vocalist of NewJeans. Born in Vietnam and raised in Australia, Hanni gained widespread popularity for her distinctive vocal tone and natural charm.
Vocalist of NewJeans. Born in Korea and raised in Australia, Danielle is known for her bilingual fluency and bright personality.
Vocalist of NewJeans. Known for her cool demeanor and feline-like visuals, Haerin has become a Dior ambassador and one of the most popular members.
Youngest member of NewJeans. Despite being the maknae, Hyein is recognized for her mature stage presence, rap skills, and tall stature.
